50760827.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal His6-tagged HDAC6 zinc-finger ubiquitin binding domain (1109 to 1215 residues)(unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC). HDAC61109–1215 was diluted to 50 μM in 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1% (v/v) DMSO. All compounds were diluted to 1 mM in the same buffer. All ITC measurements were performed at 25 °C on a Nano ITC (TA Instruments). A total of 25 injections, each of 2 μL, were delivered into a 0.167 mL sample cell at a 180 s interval. The data were analyzed using Nano Analyze software and fitted to a one-site binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Exemplary assay data of the characterization of ligand 3 by (A) SPR, (B) ITC, and (C) FP.
